card.name: Linking words in Parkinson's drug text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, with, for, -release) in Parkinson's disease drug labels, right where the next word is likely Parkinson's, PD, or a drug such as levodopa, carbidopa, DUOPA or entacapone.

modes.label: of before disease or drug
modes.description: The word 'of' after symptoms or effectiveness, ahead of Parkinson's or a drug brand name.
modes.example: Abrupt discontinuation of GOCOVRI may cause an increase in the symptoms<< of>> Parkinson's disease or cause delirium

modes.label: with after a dopaminergic drug
modes.description: The word 'with' joining one Parkinson's drug to another, such as levodopa or entacapone.
modes.example: In some patients with biopsy confirmed colitis, diarrhea had resolved or significantly improved after discontinuation of entacapone but recurred after retreatment<< with>> entacapone.

modes.label: release in drug forms
modes.description: The word 'release' in immediate-release before a Parkinson's drug name.
modes.example: compared immediate-release pramipexole tablets and immediate<<-release>> ropinirole.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward writing Parkinson's, park, or PD as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in Parkinson's drug labels, just before the disease or a related drug is named.
